name: TikTok
scope: TikTok for teens aged 13 to 17, as described in TikTok's Guardian's Guide and its Transparency Center.

teen_private.summary: TikTok says teen accounts are private by default, as part of preset settings that are turned on automatically.

evidence.quote: These features are automatically turned on and parents can further manage their teens' settings through Family Pairing.

teen_contact.summary: TikTok says accounts of teens under 16 have no direct messaging. The documents we read do not describe a default message limit for 16- and 17-year-olds.

evidence.quote: Accounts for teens under 16 years old don't have access to direct messaging features.

teen_time.summary: TikTok says daily screen time is set to 60 minutes by default for teens.

evidence.quote: Daily screen time is set by default to 60 minutes, which helps young people to be mindful about the time they spend on TikTok.

teen_night.summary: TikTok says push notifications are turned off from 9pm for teens aged 13 to 15 and from 10pm for teens aged 16 and 17.

evidence.quote: Push notifications are disabled from 9pm for teens 13-15, and from 10pm for teens 16-17.

teen_content.summary: TikTok says it works to keep content with overtly mature themes from reaching teens under 18.

evidence.quote: We also work to minimize content with overtly mature themes from reaching teens under 18 years old.

parental.summary: TikTok says Family Pairing lets parents link their account to their teen's to manage content, privacy and well-being settings.

evidence.quote: Family Pairing, which allows parents and guardians to link their accounts with their teens to manage content, privacy, and well-being settings.

feed_choice.summary: The documents we read describe a way to refresh the For You feed, but no feed without personalized recommendations for users in the United States.

evidence.quote: For You refresh: To help you discover new content, you can refresh your For You feed, enabling you to explore entirely new sides of TikTok.

ranking.summary: TikTok says its recommendation system predicts how likely you are to interact with each video, for example by liking, sharing, commenting or skipping, and ranks videos by that score.

evidence.quote: We use these signals to create a prediction score for different videos. This score is an estimate of how likely you are to interact with each of those videos.
Predictions estimate the likelihood you will interact with a given video; for example, the probability of liking, sharing, commenting, or skipping a given video.

other.summary: TikTok says the setting that suggests a teen's account to others is off by default, and that content created by users under 16 is not shown in the For You feed.

evidence.quote: The “Suggest your account to others” setting is turned off by default.
Content created by those under 16 is not eligible to be shown in the For You feed.
